title: How Crowd Worker Factors Influence Subjective Annotations: A Study of Tagging Misogynistic Hate Speech in Tweets
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith/religion. It measured crowd worker bias in annotating sexist and misogynistic hate speech on Twitter.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on how annotator factors (e.g., political inclination, personality traits, sexist attitudes) influence the labeling of misogynistic hate speech.
